desc: The Breech Plug 4-in-1 Scraper is an advanced, compact multi-tool designed specifically for maintaining muzzleloader breech plugs. This essential all-in-one tool features a push button mechanism for effortless switching between four precision-engineered cleaning components: a 1.3" flash hole cleaner with guide for fast, easy cleaning without removing the breech plug, a 1.4" U-shaped flash channel scraper to remove fouling from inside the flash channel and square and tapered scrapers to keep breech plug surfaces clean by removing stubborn fouling.
